Notes and context:
- Root cause: our early telemetry shows a transient token cache invalidation during a rolling config update in a subset of edge nodes. This caused revalidation failures for ~0.03% of requests routed through that pool.
- Impact: rejected tokens with 401 responses for a narrow subset of tenant requests. No indication of data leakage; all failures were authentication/authorization checks.
- Actions taken (timeline):
  * 02:05 UTC — monitoring alert triggered (auth-failure-rate > threshold)
  * 02:08 UTC — automated rollback to prior config for affected pool
  * 02:12 UTC — rate drop below alert threshold; knob validated at 02:14 UTC
  * 02:20 UTC — post-rollback verification and additional telemetry capture enabled

About redaction: our sample has IPs and user identifiers replaced with deterministic hashes. If Nebula needs PII-preserved artifacts for a forensic audit, we will need an NDA amendment and an approved SFTP endpoint; we can route that via your procurement/legal contact.

Wire-up plan:

- If Drive: we will create a locked folder and add laura.cheng@nebulabank.com + security@nebulabank.com.
